breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The original prompt contained a contradiction by specifying both periodic boundary conditions and a Dirichlet condition (u=0) for a periodic domain. The ground truth resolved this by removing the incorrect Dirichlet condition. The generated specification correctly omits any mention of the Dirichlet condition and consistently describes the problem on a periodic domain, aligning with the ground truth.
